Dûnyain: Secret philosophical order pursuing the Absolute via rational discipline; Kellhus is one
Probability Trance: Dûnyain cognitive state of extreme rational foresight
Thought-Gods: Alternative name for the Hundred — hostile gods of Bakker's world
No-God: The cosmic annihilator whose presence extinguishes new souls
Second Apocalypse: The prophesied return of the No-God
Gnostic sorcery: The North's metaphysical magic based on onta-grasp
Anagogic sorcery: The Three Seas' metaphysical magic based on metaphor
Cishaurim: The psukhari sorcerers who work magic through water rather than meaning
Mark of sin: The visible stain on souls who have wielded sorcery; damnation-mark
Thousandfold Thought: Kellhus's synthesis of foresight, persuasion, and will
Chorae: Trinkets that kill sorcerers on contact; anti-Mark devices
Onta: The fabric of reality graspable by sorcerers; literal stuff-of-being
Inrithism: Dominant religion of the Three Seas
Fanimry: The heretical religion of the Kianene; prophet Fane
Consult: The ancient conspiracy attempting to seal the world from the gods
World-Born: Souls born into the world before the No-God's coming; the normal case
Soulless: Children born during the No-God's presence; condition of the Second Apocalypse
